operating_mode.description:
Continuous: starts immediately, rolls over at period end, and counts continuously until reset.
Single-shot non-retriggerable: counts once after a reset, stops at period end.
Single-shot retriggerable: restarts counting on each reset event, stops at period end.

oneOf.title: Continuous
oneOf.description: The timer operates in continuous (free-running) mode.

oneOf.title: Non retriggerable single-shot

oneOf.title: Retriggerable single-shot

oneOf.title: Up-down

prescaler.description: Division ratio between the high-resolution equivalent clock frequency (fHRCK) and the HR-timer clock frequency (fHRTIM).

repetition.description: The counter repetition interrupt can be generated every period, or every 2nd, 3rd, … up to every 256th period .
repetition.title: Repetition counter

preload.title: Preload mode
preload.description: When enabled, accessed registers are shadow registers. Their content is transferred into the active register after an update request.

interleaved_mode.title: Interleaved mode
interleaved_mode.description: Interleaved mode automatically adjusts compare registers to create dual, triple, or quad phase-shifted outputs for interleaved topologies.

oneOf.title: Disabled
oneOf.description: Interleaved mode is disabled.

oneOf.title: Dual
oneOf.description: Enables dual interleaved operation. Two phase-shifted outputs are generated, typically 180° out of phase (2 interleaved phases).

oneOf.title: Triple
oneOf.description: Enables triple interleaved operation. Three phase-shifted outputs are generated, typically 120° out of phase (3 interleaved phases).

oneOf.title: Quad
oneOf.description: Enables quad interleaved operation. Four phase-shifted outputs are generated, typically 90° out of phase (4 interleaved phases).

synchronization.title: Synchronization mode
synchronization.description: Effect of an external synchronization signal on the HRTIM counter.

oneOf.title: No synchronization
oneOf.description: No external synchronization is applied to the HRTIM counter.

oneOf.title: Reset counter
oneOf.description: The HRTIM counter is reset upon receiving an external synchronization signal.

oneOf.title: Start counter
oneOf.description: The HRTIM counter is started upon receiving an external synchronization signal.

oneOf.title: Reset and start counter
oneOf.description: The HRTIM counter is reset and then started upon receiving an external synchronization signal.

burst_mode.title: Burst mode
burst_mode.description: During burst mode, the timer's counter can be stopped and reset or kept running.

oneOf.title: Maintained
oneOf.description: Timer counter clock is maintained and the timer operates normally during the burst idle period.

oneOf.title: Stopped
oneOf.description: Timer counter clock is stopped and the counter is reset during the burst idle period.

roll_over_event.title: Roll over event
roll_over_event.description: Selects, in up-down counting mode, whether roll-over is taken at 0 (valley), at the period value (crest), or at both.

update_gating.title: Update request gating
update_gating.description: Specifies how the update event is generated vs. a DMA burst operation or a rising edge on the HRTIM synchronization input.

oneOf.title: Independent from the DMA burst transfer
oneOf.description: The update event is generated according to the timer settings and is not affected by DMA burst transfers.

oneOf.title: After DMA burst transfer
oneOf.description: The update event is generated immediately after completion of a DMA burst transfer.

oneOf.title: Update after the DMA burst transfer
oneOf.description: The update event is generated on the next update request following completion of a DMA burst transfer.

oneOf.title: Rising edge on update enable input
oneOf.description: The update event is generated directly by each rising edge on the HRTIM update enable (synchronization) input.

oneOf.title: Update after rising edge on update enable input
oneOf.description: The update event is generated on the next update request following a rising edge on the HRTIM update enable (synchronization) input.

actions.message: Select "Rising edge on update enable input" or "Update event following a rising edge on update enable input" in the "Update request gating" field to enable this option.
The selected on-chip interconnect must be configured manually.

update_resync.title: Resynchronized update
update_resync.description: When enabled, update events from adjacent timers or software are applied only at the next counter reset or roll-over.

actions.message: Set "Update request gating" to "Independent from the DMA burst transfer" to enable this option.

push_pull_mode.description: When enabled, signals generated by the crossbar are applied to output 1 and output 2 alternatively, on the period basis, maintaining the other output to its inactive state.

enable.title: Delayed protection
enable.description: When enabled, PWM outputs are shut down in a delayed manner, either once the active pulse is completed or once a push-pull period is completed.

mode.description: In "Delayed idle" mode, the outputs are disabled after the current active pulse is completed. In "Balanced idle" mode, the outputs are disabled at the end of the current period in push-pull mode. oneOf.title: Balanced idle + automatic resume
oneOf.description: Keeps outputs pulse‑width balanced during protection, then automatically returns to normal operation when protection is cleared (push-pull mode only).
